# revobase

Low-level C++23 utilities for latency-sensitive RevoRacer infrastructure.

## Primary documents

- README: https://github.com/revoracer/revobase/blob/main/README.md
- License: https://github.com/revoracer/revobase/blob/main/LICENSE
- Security policy: https://github.com/revoracer/revobase/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/revoracer/revobase/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Agent instructions: https://github.com/revoracer/revobase/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Source areas

- Public headers: https://github.com/revoracer/revobase/tree/main/include/revobase
- Tests: https://github.com/revoracer/revobase/tree/main/tests
- Build script: https://github.com/revoracer/revobase/blob/main/build.sh
- CMake project: https://github.com/revoracer/revobase/blob/main/CMakeLists.txt

## Integration notes

- Requires CMake 3.23 or newer and a C++23 Clang/GCC-compatible compiler.
- Supports Linux and macOS; Windows/MSVC is not implemented.
- Link CMake target `revobase::revobase`.
- Initialize submodules before building.
- Core mmap API: `revobase::os::MmapBuffer`.
- Core timing API: `revobase::TscTimer` and `revobase::Timestamp`.
- Host-tuning APIs: `revobase::system::CpuAffinity` and
  `revobase::system::RealtimePriority`.
- Fixed-scale decimal helpers: `parse_decimal_parts`,
  `decimal_string_to_fixed`, and related functions in `DecimalUtils.h`.
- `revobase` is not a transport, broker, journal, or agent framework.
